intro: This 15 day online yoga course mixes easy-to-watch videos with live Zoom classes every day. Teachers from Rishikesh, India will guide you. You'll learn two types of yoga: Hatha (slow, steady poses) and Vinyasa (flowing movements).

Every live class (1.5 hours) also lets you practice teaching yoga to friends or family. If you're confused or have questions, you can ask the teachers directly during the live sessions. Everything is online, so you can join from home!
